title: Release readiness
intro: Four questions before we cut a release. Answer what you know; leave the rest.

questions.question: Has the change been exercised outside the test suite?
questions.why: a green suite and a working feature are different claims

questions.question: How was it exercised?
questions.why: tells the next person what is already covered

questions.question: Does anything here change behaviour people already rely on?
questions.why: decides whether this is a minor bump or a note in the changelog nobody can miss

questions.question: If this turns out badly, how does someone undo it?
questions.why: the answer is usually short, and its absence is the finding
